scene.note: server.js runs Imran's report as a separate program for the month a member asks for, and answers with what it says.

steps.note: A member asks for the report of a month.
The server starts the report program on the same Node, with the month as its argument, and goes on serving others.
Once the report has ended, the server has all it printed.
It answers with the report, exactly as printed.
A member asks for a month that cannot be, or one with no readings.
The report ends with an exit code that says which, and prints its reason on its error stream.
The server picks the status from the exit code and passes the reason on.
The server tries to run the report, but the program has been moved, or cannot be started.
It notices the failure, whether it came as an exit code or as an error, without stopping.
It answers that the report could not be made, and keeps serving.
Someone types signs a shell would read as more commands after the month.
The server starts the report directly, with the month as one argument, so no shell ever reads it.
The report says it is not a month, and nothing else runs on the laptop.
